data.description: Capture the live parallax.haus hero animation, a full homepage scroll-through, every major homepage section, and each top-level page; then publish a rich Software portfolio entry that presents the site as a complete shipped architecture × software identity project rather than a prototype. Do not click through every architecture project. Verify media and the live build.
data.title: Document Parallax Haus as a full software project post

data.body: Implementation committed locally as 1b1e9e4. QA passed: 13 stills visually inspected at 1440x900; hero and one-way scroll videos inspected and verified H.264/yuv420p, 1000x626, 24 fps, no audio, faststart; manifest integrity and prior-record preservation passed; 40/40 tests, tsc, build, and lint passed (pre-existing warnings only); desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 Software card/lightbox checks passed across all 15 views. Production homepage, five primary routes, and repository URL return 200. Git push and PR creation await explicit user approval after the approval reviewer blocked exporting the captured assets to GitHub; no push retry was attempted.

Independent review outcome: Pass.

Reviewed commit 1b1e9e4 on feature/ASMV-115-parallax-haus-post against main d19a8e6 and the canonical ASMV-115 plan. The implementation-level acceptance criteria are satisfied; no code or asset corrections are required.

Scope and repository hygiene:
- Diff is limited to 20 intended task files: pipeline/capture.mjs, three Parallax capture helpers, src/data/works.json, and exactly 15 final assets under public/lab/parallax-haus/.
- No tracked node_modules, symlink, WebM, contact-sheet, pipeline/.tmp, or unrelated artifacts; worktree is clean after QA.
- works.json is append-only for the new record, so prior records remain unchanged.
- The optional capture.mjs --browser-path change is narrow and correct: it resolves and validates a supplied executable path, then conditionally passes Playwright executablePath; existing default launch behavior remains unchanged. node --check passed for capture.mjs and all three new helpers.

Manifest/content:
- parallax-haus is unique id/number 13, max number 13, dated 2026-07-27, sorts newest-first, and is labeled Ship.
- Live and repo links are https://parallax.haus/ and https://github.com/jannar18/parallax; tags/copy accurately highlight the architecture x software identity, generative canvas, book-like browsing, responsive motion, and Riso-inspired system.
- No Parallax record field contains prototype framing.
- The 15-view story is ordered correctly: hero lead; one-way scroll; eight homepage stills in page order; Software, Architecture, Archive, Writing, and About. Every referenced local file exists. Architecture is the flipbook opening/cover at 1/21 only.

Media QA:
- hero-animation.mp4: 7.166667 s, 1000x626, H.264, yuv420p, 24 fps, no audio, 521,941 bytes, moov before mdat/faststart. Frame review shows the untouched opening state, complete autonomous fold, and settled ending.
- home-scroll.mp4: 25.083333 s, 1000x626, H.264, yuv420p, 24 fps, no audio, 2,912,024 bytes, moov before mdat/faststart. Frame review shows a readable, downward-only walkthrough from the settled hero through Software, Architecture, the merged composition/clip experience, manifesto, Studio Desk, and footer.
- All 13 PNGs are 1440x900. Full contact-sheet plus key full-size inspection found no blank/loading captures, browser chrome, clipped headers, accidental hover states, or unreadable framing; all eight requested homepage moments and five primary pages are present.

Independent verification:
- pnpm test: 40/40 tests passed (2 files).
- pnpm exec tsc --noEmit: passed.
- pnpm build: passed; 22/22 static pages generated.
- pnpm lint: passed with five pre-existing warnings in untouched ClipReel.tsx, RisoImage.tsx, and hero-canvas.ts only.
- Local desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 Playwright smoke passed: Parallax Haus is the first card; card/lightbox show Ship and not Prototype; lead video is autoplay/loop/muted; Live/Repo hrefs are correct; carousel has 15 views; ArrowRight and direct-dot navigation reach views 2 and 15; final image is present; close receives focus; Escape closes and restores body scrolling; mobile has no horizontal overflow and the dialog fits 390x844. One transient console 404 appeared in the first pass, but a focused retry recorded no HTTP responses >=400 and no page errors; it did not reproduce.

Remaining acceptance work is deliberately external, not implementation rework: after explicit user approval, push the feature branch, open/merge the PR, wait for Vercel, then verify the production /work/software entry, all 15 media URLs, primary routes, and console/network before using the normal Lattice completion ceremony. Do not mark ASMV-115 done yet.

Review cycle 1 implemented in commit f4694f0. Replaced exactly four PNG assets with Julianna's supplied full-resolution captures while preserving filenames and the 15-item carousel order: home-studio-desk.png, home-manifesto.png, home-footer.png, and page-architecture.png. Visual QA passed for all four. Each replacement is 3024x1652; the other nine PNGs remain 1440x900. works.json parses, the Parallax record still references 15 unique existing media files in the unchanged order, and repository/deliverable SHA-256 pairs match for all four replacements. pnpm test passed 40/40. The same four files were synced to the Codex user-facing site-media package. No source, manifest, or other media changed; no build rerun was needed for binary-only replacements. No push/PR/merge performed.

Review cycle 1 PASS for commit f4694f0. Independent review verified exactly four intended PNG replacements from 1b1e9e4; every repo asset matches Julianna's specified source byte-for-byte and matches the synchronized outputs copy. All four are valid 3024x1652 RGBA PNGs with correct Studio Desk, manifesto quote, dark footer, and full-page Architecture content. works.json and carousel order are unchanged; all 15 unique media references resolve. Exact commit archive passes 40/40 tests, git diff --check passes, and worktree is clean. No push/PR/merge/deploy performed.

Review cycle 2 implementation committed locally as 7bca712. Changed only src/data/works.json: Parallax Haus date 2026-07-27 -> 2026-03-25. getAllWorks date-desc sort now yields the exact local sequence Parallax Haus -> Snails vs Garden -> Arch Voice MCP while preserving every other record and relative order. JSON parses; all 15 unique Parallax media paths exist; git diff --check passes; pnpm test passes 40/40 (2 files). Initial test invocation could not find vitest because this worktree had no dependencies, so the frozen lockfile was installed from the local pnpm store offline and the required test command was rerun successfully. No gallery code, other records, media, push, PR, merge, deploy, or completion action performed.

Review cycle 2 outcome: PASS for commit 7bca712. Independent review verified the commit changes only src/data/works.json and only the Parallax Haus date from 2026-07-27 to 2026-03-25. The actual Software rendering path passes getAllWorks output directly to LabGallery, whose map preserves the date-descending order; the resulting local sequence is exactly Parallax Haus -> Snails vs Garden -> Arch Voice MCP. Removing Parallax Haus from before/after sorted lists yields identical visible-order arrays, so every other visible work retains its prior relative order. The Parallax record is otherwise byte-for-byte equivalent to f4694f0: Ship label, live/repo links, description, lead MP4, and 14 ordered screenshots remain intact. All 15 media paths are unique and exist under public/lab/parallax-haus; the directory contains exactly those 15 files. pnpm test passes 40/40 across 2 files; git diff --check passes; HEAD is 7bca712 and the worktree is clean. No push, PR, merge, deploy, or completion action performed; ASMV-115 remains in review for the authorized ship step.

Shipped Parallax Haus to the live Software gallery as a Ship via PR #119 (merge ed4eddd). Final order verified live as Parallax Haus → Snails vs Garden → Arch Voice MCP with all other entries preserving relative order. Entry includes 15-view carousel: hero animation, one-way scroll video, eight homepage captures, and five primary-page captures including Julianna's four preferred replacements. All three implementation/review cycles passed; tests 40/40, typecheck/build/lint, desktop/mobile QA, and media QA passed. Vercel production deployment succeeded. Live Software card, 15 carousel controls, direct navigation to views 8 and 12, six primary routes, and all 15 media URLs verified in production; every URL returned HTTP 200.
